crossRefs.note: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things…
Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”
When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’ ”
translations.bsb: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
translations.kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
translations.asv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, if one rise from the dead.
